_comment: THE IDENTITY testing/rebrand.test.sh PINS ITS FIXTURES TO. That suite tests the rename ENGINE — held values, word boundaries, the workspace segment of a secret ref, idempotence across phases — and its fixtures spell out one baseline's identity literally (secret://lumen/cirrus/..., cirrus.app, Cirrus-Webhooks, and the glued `cirrus.appcirrus` boundary case). Pinning it here keeps the suite deterministic and independent of whichever repository hosts the factory: passed as --baseline-identity, it no longer matters what this tree's own .baseline/identity.json says. These are cirrus's values because the fixtures were written against them.
